evidence: music-clip LESSONS, 2.11.0 - 2026-11-07 - gravitone-gcloud - Unlatched PAUSED: state and what was learned
text: Still unsolved, and why the operator stopped: objects she handles (the hoodie reads as a towel, headphones turn to rings), slow face and hair drift across takes, and a retake for most new faults at about 25 min each. Each take seeds the next, so a late retake also re-renders what follows it. Wording repaints: "rain on the window" invents a window, and the unseen wall got a curtained one anyway once the camera turned there.
